title: FlashTask
description: Input schema for the Flash Flowsheet engine (flash_engine.py). Topology: Feed → Cool-1 → FFEED → Flash1 → V + L. No valve.

components.description: Dict of {component_name: mole_fraction}. Keys must be valid DWSIM compound database names (case-sensitive). Values must sum to 1.0 (±0.02).

pressure_Pa.description: Feed stream pressure [Pa]. Must be greater than flash_pressure_Pa.

flash_type.description: Flash specification type. Currently only 'PT' (pressure-temperature) is supported.

property_package.description: Thermodynamic property package. Auto-selected if omitted (PR for non-polar, NRTL for polar). Accepts aliases e.g. 'Peng-Robinson' normalizes to 'PR'.

cooler_temp_K.description: Cooler outlet temperature [K]. Optional — defaults to temperature_K - 90 if omitted.

flash_pressure_Pa.description: Flash drum operating pressure [Pa]. Optional — defaults to pressure_Pa × 0.971 if omitted. Must be less than pressure_Pa.

feed_flow_molh.description: Feed molar flow rate [mol/h]. Optional, defaults to 100.0 mol/h.

_note: task_type is NOT a required field here. The pipeline router (run_pipeline.bat) detects task_type from the orchestrator JSON and calls flash_engine.py directly.

professor_example._validated: Cooler removes 10345.38 kW, V_frac=0.906, V=5074 kmol/h, L=522 kmol/h

removed: task_type         — no longer required in this file
valve_pressure_Pa — removed, no valve in current topology
cooler_temp_K     — now optional with smart default (temperature_K - 90)
_field_changes_from_v1.components_format: Changed from array+feed_composition to single dict {name: mole_fraction}
